Lead notes.
- Your target weight is not set. No cut guidance is included until you enter current and target weights.
- Primary goal: recovery, building tissue tolerance and freshness this phase. Speed and power are secondary supports, not the main job right now. Power development is missing in the D-15 to D-2 window and will not be added here to protect recovery.

GPP - Week 1 (D-52 to D-46) - Restore structural tolerance, aerobic support, and technical rhythm.

D-52 (Wednesday) - Ring Cut-Off Walkdown
Why: low-cost footwork practice to press angles without chasing.
- Ring Cut-Off Walkdown: 2 x 90 sec technical sets; rest 60 sec. Cue: Follow a self-planned or random visual escape path and close the angle without crossing the feet or chasing. Side / Stance: Work both directions evenly from your normal stance.
Progress: none this block.
Stop: stop the set if you start chasing or taking off-balance steps.

D-52 (Wednesday) - Strength (primary strength day)
Why: build explosive hip power and single-leg control early in camp.
- Kettlebell Swing: 4 sets x 5 reps; rest 90 sec; intent crisp. Cue: Hips drive the movement, let the bell swing not your arms. Purpose: repeated hip power for punch speed and recoil. Progress: next session add 1 rep to each set. Easier: drop 1 set. Stop: stop the set when snap speed slows or form breaks.
- Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift Hold: 3 sets x 8 reps; tempo 3-1-3; rest 90 sec; RPE 7. Cue: hinge from the hips, keep a long line through the standing leg. Purpose: single-leg balance and posterior chain control. Progress: next session add 1 rep per set. Easier: reduce range of motion. Stop: stop if hip or lower back pain appears.
- Lat Pulldown: 3 sets x 8 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 6. Cue: pull to chest, keep torso steady. Purpose: upper-back strength for posture under guard. Progress: next session add 1 rep total across sets. Easier: reduce reps to 6 per set. Stop: stop if shoulder pain or swinging appears.
- DB Alternating Incline Press (30-45°): 3 sets x 8 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 6. Cue: drive with the chest, control the descent. Purpose: shoulder and pressing durability for power shots. Progress: next session add 1 rep across sets. Easier: lower to 2 sets. Stop: stop for sharp shoulder pain.

D-52 (Wednesday) - Strength (secondary strength day)
Why: build force capacity and low-noise work that supports balance.
- Sled Push (Board): 4 carries x 30 m; rest 90 sec; RPE 7. Cue: drive through the legs, keep a flat back and steady breathing. Purpose: loaded leg drive and carry power. Progress: next session add 1 carry. Easier: reduce distance to 20 m. Stop: stop for loss of steady posture.
- Jump Rope (Weighted Vest): 4 rounds x 75 sec work; rest 45 sec; RPE 5. Cue: light bounce, keep rhythm on the balls of the feet. Purpose: rhythm under load, foot quickness. Progress: next session add 15 sec per round. Easier: remove the vest. Stop: stop if calf pain or dizziness occurs.
- Z Press: 3 sets x 10 reps @ 65% 1RM; tempo 3-1-1; rest 90 sec. Cue: sit tall, press with legs braced. Purpose: overhead stability and shoulder drive. Progress: next session add 1 rep each set. Easier: reduce to 8 reps. Stop: stop if shoulder pain or loss of control.

D-50 (Friday) - Alactic sharpness
Why: short max-intent leg power to keep explosiveness fresh.
- Broad Jump Repeats: 6 rounds x 3 reps; rest 120 sec. Cue: full intent jump and stick landing, reset fully between reps. Purpose: hip drive and first-step power. Progress: next session add 1 rep total across sets. Easier: reduce to 4 rounds. Stop: stop if landing control or knees feel unstable.

Your declared hard-sparring/contact session, no extra S&C. Keep freshness priority.

D-47 (Monday) - Aerobic support
Why: build steady aerobic base for recovery and repeatability.
- Easy Assault Bike: 25 min continuous; nasal breathing only; RPE 4. Cue: settle into an easy, repeatable cadence and breathe through the nose. Purpose: recovery aerobic base and better recovery between efforts. Progress: next session add 5 min. Easier: 20 min. Stop: stop for unusual breathlessness or lightheadedness.

GPP - Week 2 (D-45 to D-39) - Build repeatability and general force.

D-45 (Wednesday) - Strength (primary strength day)
Why: keep anchor strength crisp after recovery day.
- Kettlebell Swing: 4 sets x 5 reps; rest 90 sec. Cue: hips drive, finish with a tight glute squeeze. Purpose: repeated alactic power for punch speed. Progress: next session add 1 rep. Easier: drop to 3 sets. Stop: stop if snap speed drops or low back twinge appears.
- Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift Hold: 3 sets x 8 reps; tempo 3-1-3; rest 90 sec; RPE 7. Cue: slow control on the way down, steady balance. Purpose: balance and trunk control. Progress: next session add 1 rep. Easier: reduce range. Stop: stop for instability or pain.
- Lat Pulldown: 3 sets x 8 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 6. Cue: drive elbows down, chest up. Purpose: posture and pulling strength. Progress: next session add 1 rep. Easier: reduce to 2 sets. Stop: stop if shoulder pain arises.
- DB Alternating Incline Press (30-45°): 3 sets x 8 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 6. Cue: control the descent, explode up. Purpose: pressing power and upper-body durability. Progress: next session add 1 rep. Easier: lower load. Stop: stop for sharp shoulder pain.

D-44 (Thursday) - Aerobic support
Why: steady aerobic work to aid recovery and repeatability.
- Easy Assault Bike: 25 min continuous; nasal breathing only; RPE 4. Cue: easy cadence, relaxed shoulders. Purpose: recover and set a base. Progress: next session add 5 min. Easier: 20 min. Stop: stop for dizziness.

D-43 (Friday) - Alactic sharpness
Why: keep short explosive quality under low fatigue.
- Broad Jump Repeats: 6 rounds x 3 reps; rest 120 sec. Cue: max intent, stick landing. Purpose: first-step power. Progress: next session add 1 rep total. Easier: 4 rounds. Stop: stop if landings feel unsafe.

GPP - Week 3 (D-38 to D-33) - Bridge general work toward transfer.

D-38 (Wednesday) - Strength (primary strength day)
Why: maintain anchor strength while we shift to transfer work.
- Kettlebell Swing: 4 sets x 5 reps; rest 90 sec. Cue: snap hips, keep chest tall. Purpose: power and speed endurance. Progress: next session add 1 rep. Easier: reduce to 3 sets. Stop: stop if low-back pain appears.
- Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift Hold: 3 sets x 8 reps; tempo 3-1-3; rest 90 sec; RPE 7. Cue: slow lowering, balanced finish. Purpose: single-leg control. Progress: next session add 1 rep. Easier: reduce ROM. Stop: stop for instability.
- Lat Pulldown: 3 sets x 8 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 6. Cue: pull with lats, avoid shrugging. Purpose: upper-back strength. Progress: next session add 1 rep. Easier: reduce load. Stop: stop for shoulder pain.
- DB Alternating Incline Press (30-45°): 3 sets x 8 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 6. Cue: press steadily, alternate arms smoothly. Purpose: pressing durability for fight shots. Progress: next session add 1 rep. Easier: reduce reps.

D-37 (Thursday) - Aerobic support
Why: keep recovery aerobic base in place midweek.
- Easy Assault Bike: 25 min continuous; nasal breathing only; RPE 4. Cue: smooth rhythm, steady breathing. Purpose: recovery and repeatability. Progress: none this block. Easier: 20 min. Stop: stop if breath control fails.

D-36 (Friday) - Alactic sharpness

D-38 (Wednesday) - 45-Degree Angle Step to Jab Reset
Why: technical footwork practice for creating attacking angles.
- 45-Degree Angle Step to Jab Reset: 2 x 75 sec technical sets; rest 60 sec. Cue: on a random visual cue take a 45-degree angle and reset behind the jab. Purpose: angle creation quality, not speed. Progress: none this block. Stop: stop the set if angle quality drops.

SPP - Week 4 (D-32 to D-26) - Shift to fight-specific stress and transfer.

D-31 (Wednesday) - Easy Walk Flush
Why: low-cost recovery to finish feeling fresher.
- Easy Walk Flush: nose-breathing pace only; duration 20 min. Cue: easy pace, no sweat target. Purpose: recover and clear legs. Progress: none this block. Stop: stop if breath rate exceeds easy zone.

D-30 (Thursday) - Alactic sharpness
Why: explosive entry and exit practice, fight specific.
- Entry-Score-Exit Bursts: 8 rounds x 6 sec work; rest 60 sec; RPE 8. Cue: step in hard, land 1-3 clean shots, exit at an angle. Purpose: punch entry speed and exit control. Progress: next session add 1 rep if everything is crisp. Easier: reduce rounds to 6. Stop: stop when technique degrades.
- Straight-Shot Re-Angle: 8 rounds x 6 sec work; rest 60 sec; RPE 8. Cue: one explosive jab-cross, then 30-45 degree exit. Purpose: re-angle after shots. Progress: next session add 1 round. Easier: reduce to 6 rounds. Stop: stop if re-angle loses control.

SPP - Week 5 (D-25 to D-19) - Make fight-specific repeatability the main job.

D-24 (Wednesday) - Pressure Step-Cut Reset
Why: reactive lateral brakes and base reset for SPP quality.
- Pressure Step-Cut Reset: 2 sets x 4 clean reactions each direction; rest 75 sec between sets; duration per rep dynamic. Cue: react to a partner exit or random cue, cut the lane and rebuild the base before the next rep. Purpose: read-and-cut practice. Progress: next session add 1 clean reaction per set. Easier: reduce reps. Stop: stop when braking control fails.

D-23 (Thursday) - Alactic sharpness
Why: fight-specific entry speed and exit under fatigue.
- Entry-Score-Exit Bursts: 8 rounds x 6 sec work; rest 60 sec; RPE 8. Cue: explosive step-in, immediate exit. Purpose: explosive entries and quick exits. Progress: none this block. Easier: reduce rounds to 6. Stop: stop if technique falls apart.
- Straight-Shot Re-Angle: 8 rounds x 6 sec work; rest 60 sec; RPE 8. Cue: fast jab-cross then angle exit. Purpose: re-angle and reset. Progress: none this block. Easier: reduce rounds to 6. Stop: stop if re-angle is sloppy.

D-22 (Friday) - Aerobic support
Why: sustain fight-pace repeatability and recovery.
- Pressure Footwork Flow: 3 rounds x 180 sec work; rest 45 sec. Cue: controlled stalking pace, reset stance after entries. Purpose: aerobic fight-flow repeatability. Progress: none this block. Easier: 2 rounds. Stop: stop for balance loss.

TAPER - Week 7 (D-12 to D-7) - Strip out fatigue and keep sharpness.

D-12 (Monday) - Neural speed touch
Why: a small neural touch to keep first-step and rhythm without fatigue.
- Explosive First-Step Cue: 2 rounds x 5 sec work; rest 120 sec. Cue: explosive first step, full reset between reps. Purpose: first-step speed and timing. Progress: none this block. Easier: 1 round. Stop: stop if you feel heavy or flat.
- Step-Jab-Cutoff Cue: 1 round x 5 sec work; rest 120 sec. Cue: small step into a jab then cutoff. Purpose: timing and angle entry. Progress: none this block. Easier: skip. Stop: stop if you feel pushed beyond crispness.
- Pocket Frame-Burst Touch: 1 round x 5 sec work; rest 120 sec. Cue: quick frame and burst, reset fully. Purpose: pocket control and short-burst speed. Progress: none this block. Easier: skip. Stop: stop if technique blurs.

D-11 (Tuesday) - Technical-only combat
Technical-only contact today, no hard sparring and no extra S&C. Keep freshness priority.

D-10 (Wednesday) - Rhythm flush
Why: keep tempo and breathing under easy fight-pace stress.
- Tempo Shadowboxing: 20 min continuous; RPE 4-5. Cue: controlled tempo, focus on breathing and technique, no power. Purpose: rhythm, technical flow. Progress: none this block. Easier: 15 min. Stop: stop if heart rate spikes.

D-0 (Saturday) - Fight day protocol
Fight day protocol: follow coach warm-up and fight protocol, no additional S&C.

Notes and small rules.
- Hard sparring days remain your declared collision days. From D-14 onward these are technical-only in this plan to protect freshness. Where D-days show "Technical-only combat" treat those as technical contact only.
- If any set or rep causes sharp joint pain, stop immediately and report it to your coach or a clinician.
- No rehab headings are included per plan settings; joint prep and mobility appear as Movement Prep, Joint Prep, Walk Flush, or Visualization only.

End of plan.
